notes.say: Thank you for the kickoff call. This deck is the plan for your new site, built from what you told us and from our keyword research. It describes direction, not guarantees.
notes.emphasise: The plan describes direction, not guarantees.
notes.pushback: Pushback: you promised us a top ranking within a month. Answer: that is your goal, and we treat it as one, but search results depend on factors outside anyone's control, so we do not promise it.

slides.headline: Larkspur has no website, so emergency patients in Boise cannot find you

stats.caption: monthly searches for emergency dentist boise

body: The practice has no website today, only the registered domain larkspurdental.com.
No Boise practice has a dedicated emergency page in the top 5 results yet.

notes.say: Today there is nothing online for a person with a cracked tooth to land on. Emergency care is the fastest-growing part of your practice, and that is where the search demand is.
notes.emphasise: 1,300 monthly searches for emergency dentist boise, at a difficulty of 32.
notes.pushback: Pushback: is emergency search really big enough to matter? Answer: it is one of the largest Tier 1 terms and one of the easier ones to win, and nobody in Boise has a dedicated page in the top 5.

slides.headline: Meridian families and implant patients searching today have no way to find you

stats.caption: monthly searches for dentist meridian idaho
monthly searches for dental implants boise

body: Both are services you told us matter most.

notes.say: Without a site, every one of these searches goes to another practice. Implants and your second service area are where you said you want growth.
notes.emphasise: 1,600 searches for dentist meridian idaho and 880 for dental implants boise.
notes.pushback: Pushback: will we get all of those searches? Answer: no. These are monthly search volumes, not patients, and we do not promise a share or a patient number.

notes.say: These are your words from the kickoff call. Each one shaped a decision in this plan, and we will point to them as we go.
notes.emphasise: Same-day emergency care leads, in your own words.
notes.pushback: Pushback: our priorities have changed since the call. Answer: tell us now and we will update the Blueprint before the pages are written.

notes.say: Section one is where you stand today: what you already have and what the search market looks like.
notes.emphasise: Your reputation is already an asset.

slides.headline: Your reputation is strong, but it has no website to work on yet

stats.caption: average rating across your Google reviews

body: The new site will put this proof where new patients decide.

notes.say: Patients already rate you highly. The site's job is to put that rating in front of people at the moment they choose a dentist.
notes.pushback: Pushback: can we say best dentist in Boise? Answer: no. Dental advertising is held to honest-claims rules, so we use only real, current ratings and proof points.

notes.say: Tier 1 keywords are the main keywords of the pages we are building now. Tier 2 is for the first months after launch, and Tier 3 builds long-term authority.
notes.emphasise: Emergency dentist boise: 1,300 searches a month at a difficulty of 32.
notes.pushback: Pushback: why not target the biggest terms first? Answer: they are harder, and authority from the service pages comes first. The next slide covers it.

slides.eyebrow: Why Your Top Keyword Isn't Month One
slides.headline: Dentist boise is the long game, so it is not a day-one target

stats.caption: monthly searches, at a difficulty of 61

points: It is the biggest search term, and also one of the hardest to win.
We build authority through the service pages first.
We aim at it after launch, not on day one.

notes.say: We know this is the term you would most like to own. It needs authority that a new site does not have, so we earn it through the service pages first.
notes.emphasise: 6,600 monthly searches at a difficulty of 61.
notes.pushback: Pushback: you said you wanted to be the top dentist on Google within a month. Answer: that is your goal, and we do not promise a ranking, because this term needs authority built over time.

notes.say: Section two is the plan itself: how you are positioned and what we are building.
notes.pushback: Pushback: can the order change? Answer: yes, tell us and the Blueprint changes before pages are written.

slides.headline: Same-day emergency care is what sets Larkspur apart from other Boise practices
slides.message: The calm, same-day family practice that treats emergencies and implants under one roof.

notes.say: This is the message the first screen of the homepage will carry and every page will keep repeating. It leads with the differentiator you gave us.
notes.pushback: Pushback: awards and press are missing. Answer: none have been found, so we do not lean on them. If you have any, send them and we will use them.

slides.headline: The new site gives every service you want found its own page

notes.say: Each service you want to be found for gets a page matched to a Tier 1 keyword, plus Meridian, About, Our Team, New Patients and Contact pages. Every page has a clear way to book or call.
notes.pushback: Pushback: why only 11 counted pages? Answer: the home page, contact page, 404 page, privacy and terms pages and blog posts are part of the site but not counted against the scope.

slides.headline: We are leaving three things out so the plan stays honest and in scope

items.why: It is outside the agreed 12-page scope, so it is not in this plan.
items.revisit: If the scope is changed in a new agreement

items.what: Blog writing as part of the build
items.why: Blog writing is outside the current agreement, so the content calendar is a plan to agree on, not work already included.
items.revisit: If blog writing is added to the agreement

items.why: Search results depend on factors outside anyone's control, so we describe direction and do not guarantee a ranking or a patient number.

notes.say: Saying no clearly now avoids a hard conversation later. Each of these has an event that would make it worth revisiting.
notes.pushback: Pushback: why not just add the insurance pages? Answer: they are outside the current scope, and we will revisit them if the scope changes.
